svg.text: Smart Closet Mirror — D1 Data Model (L4 Wardrobe + L5 fit cache)
Goal: Turn a Gen 1 Mirror into a closet mirror that measures the user with a Kinect, shows their own clothes and shop items
on their body, and tells them what to wear today and whether a new piece is worth buying.
Scope: entities owned by L4 Wardrobe, plus the BodyProfile rows L5 reads and the FitResult cache L5 writes. One SQLite database; image files on disk.
Box = entity (one table). Rows = key attributes only, not every column. Line = relationship; italic word reads from the first-named entity.
Cardinality is drawn at BOTH ends in crow's-foot notation and repeated as text (1, 0..1, 1..*, 0..*). The symbol nearest an entity says how many of THAT entity.
PK = primary key (also underlined) · FK = foreign key · UQ = unique · UQ1 = fields unique together · IX = indexed for lookup.
